cases.title: Page report history by scheduled time

expected_defect.summary: Cursor pagination skips rows sharing the boundary scheduled_at timestamp because next_cursor stores only scheduled_at and filters WHERE scheduled_at < ?, ignoring the id tie-breaker when multiple reports share the same second.
Replacing csv.writer with ','.join(map(str, row)) removes RFC 4180 CSV quoting/escaping, corrupting output when report names contain commas, quotes, or newlines.
range(0, len(jobs) - batch_size + 1, batch_size) drops remainder jobs when len(jobs) is not a multiple of 20 (including any queue with < 20 jobs), leaving due jobs undelivered.
Dropping legacy_format during an online migration breaks active workers-17 replicas on site 'elm' that still execute SELECT id, legacy_format FROM deliveries.
Increasing EXPORT_BATCH_SIZE from 25 to 50 exceeds max_rows_per_request=40 on site 'cedar' (archive-11), causing oversized archive requests (70 ready rows) to be rejected in full.
Routing new deliveries to 'report-dispatch' strands 8 due jobs on site 'elm' because elm workers only subscribe to ['reports'].
